failure.title: Screenshot journey navigated before expected queue reads settled
failure.note: The responsive screenshot journey produced all 20 images, then retained a trace showing the next navigation cancel an in-flight queue API read that the strict runtime guard classified as unexpected.
failure.diagnosis: Heading readiness was sufficient for capture but not for request-lifecycle completion. Immediate navigation then aborted legitimate page reads, creating a harness-owned cancellation rather than a product network failure.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
